sentences.en: During the war, soldiers used radiograms to send urgent messages.
sentences.zh: 战争期间，士兵使用无线电报发送紧急信息。

sentences.en: The radiogram arrived late due to bad weather conditions.
sentences.zh: 由于天气恶劣，电报送达得很晚。

sentences.en: They sent a radiogram announcing the birth of their new baby.
sentences.zh: 他们发送无线电报宣布新生儿出生的消息。
